records.context: ``n`` **is the number of rows the matrix actually contains**, and the supports sum to it. A row whose true class the head has no column for is counted as an error rather than dropped: the matrix grows to hold it, and the missing column stays empty because the head can never predict that class. Reporting ``n`` over one population and ``accuracy`` over another is the one thing a model card must not do — a three-class held-out set scored by a binary head used to report a perfect score on a set the model got two of three right, and the ``accuracy == trace / total`` invariant still checked out because the row was missing from both sides of it.

records.context: **The pyramid.** ``levels=1`` writes level 0 alone; more builds each level by halving the two fastest-varying space axes of the one above with a 2x **block mean** (``downsample="mean"``) or by **striding** (``downsample="stride"``). Neither is a Gaussian pyramid — there is no pre-filter beyond the box — and the block mean is the default because striding aliases: a one-pixel-wide bright structure survives or vanishes with the parity of its coordinate, so the same object appears and disappears as a user zooms. **Label and mask arrays must use** ``downsample="stride"``: the mean of labels 3 and 5 is 4, which is a different object, and averaging a boolean mask invents half-membership. Levels shrink by ``ceil(n / 2)``, so nothing is cropped off an odd edge.
records.label: spacr.ome_zarr.write_ome_zarr#2
records.source: **The pyramid.** ``levels=1`` writes level 0 alone; more builds each level by halving the two fastest-varying space axes of the one above with a 2x **block mean** (``downsample="mean"``) or by **striding** (``downsample="stride"``). Neither is a Gaussian pyramid — there is no pre-filter beyond the box — and the block mean is the default because striding aliases: a one-pixel-wide bright structure survives or vanishes with the parity of its coordinate, so the same object appears and disappears as a user zooms. **Label and mask arrays must use** ``downsample="stride"``: the mean of labels 3 and 5 is 4, which is a different object, and averaging a boolean mask invents half-membership. Levels shrink by ``ceil(n / 2)``, so nothing is cropped off an odd edge.
records.translation: **金字塔。** ``levels=1`` 只写出第 0 层;层数更多时,每一层都通过把上一层中变化最快的两个空间轴减半来构建,方式是 2x **块均值** ( ``downsample="mean"`` )或 **步进抽样** ( ``downsample="stride"`` )。两者都不是高斯金字塔——除了块本身之外没有预滤波——之所以默认使用块均值,是因为步进抽样会产生混叠:一个一像素宽的亮结构能否保留取决于其坐标的奇偶性,因此同一个对象会在用户缩放时时隐时现。 **标签和掩码数组必须使用** ``downsample="stride"`` :标签 3 和 5 的均值是 4,那是另一个对象,而对布尔掩码取平均会凭空造出“半个成员”。各层按 ``ceil(n / 2)`` 缩小,因此奇数边缘不会被裁掉任何内容。

records.context: **Nothing here needs root**, and nothing here touches the operating system's own memory. No ``drop_caches``, no ``sysctl``, no ``swapoff``. records.translation: **这里的任何操作都不需要 root 权限**,也不会触碰操作系统自身的内存。没有 ``drop_caches`` ,没有 ``sysctl`` ,也没有 ``swapoff`` 。页面缓存属于内核,清空它会拖慢整台机器,包括 spaCR 在内——这不是白得的好处,而是把所有人的资源转给了没有人。

records.context: ``clear RAM`` Drops spaCR's own caches: the merged-microscope field of view LRU (:func:`spacr.crops.clear_field_cache` — by far the largest, whole image stacks), the file-format and DB-format caches, the zoomed-animation cache, the icon and preview ``lru_cache``\ s, the filter-kind cache, every live :class:`~spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails` thumbnail LRU, and Qt's own ``QPixmapCache``. A process with no live Qt application also runs ``gc.collect()``. The GUI deliberately does not: walking a heap of live Qt wrappers can enter already-retired C++ objects and crash the process. It cannot return memory the allocator has decided to keep, and it says so when the measured RSS does not move.
records.label: spacr.qt.resource_cleanup#9
records.source: ``clear RAM`` Drops spaCR's own caches: the merged-field LRU (:func:`spacr.crops.clear_field_cache` — by far the largest, whole image stacks), the file-format and DB-format caches, the zoomed-animation cache, the icon and preview ``lru_cache``\ s, the filter-kind cache, every live :class:`~spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails` thumbnail LRU, and Qt's own ``QPixmapCache``. A process with no live Qt application also runs ``gc.collect()``. The GUI deliberately does not: walking a heap of live Qt wrappers can enter already-retired C++ objects and crash the process. It cannot return memory the allocator has decided to keep, and it says so when the measured RSS does not move.
records.translation: ``clear RAM`` 清空 spaCR 自身的缓存:合并显微镜视野的 LRU 缓存( :func:`spacr.crops.clear_field_cache` ——迄今为止最大的一个,存放整个图像堆栈)、文件格式和 DB 格式缓存、缩放动画缓存、图标和预览的 ``lru_cache``\ s、过滤器类型缓存、每个活动的 :class:`~spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails` 缩略图 LRU,以及 Qt 自身的 ``QPixmapCache`` 。没有运行中 Qt 应用程序的进程还会执行 ``gc.collect()`` 。 GUI 刻意不这样做:遍历由活动 Qt 包装对象组成的堆,可能会访问已经销毁的 C++ 对象并导致进程崩溃。它无法归还分配器决定保留的内存,并会在测得的 RSS 没有变化时如实说明。

records.context: Never ``SELECT *`` the whole table. Measurement tables run to hundreds of thousands of rows and hundreds of feature columns. The first chunk (100 rows) is fetched and painted on its own; the rest arrives as the user scrolls, through ``canFetchMore`` / ``fetchMore``.

records.source: Never ``SELECT *`` the whole table. Measurement tables run to hundreds of thousands of rows and hundreds of feature columns. The first chunk (100 rows) is fetched and painted on its own; the rest arrives as the user scrolls, through ``canFetchMore`` / ``fetchMore``.
records.translation: 绝不要对整张表执行 ``SELECT *`` 。测量表可达数十万行、数百个特征列。第一块数据(100 行)会单独获取并绘制;其余部分随着用户滚动,通过 ``canFetchMore`` / ``fetchMore`` 陆续到达。

records.context: **The count never blocks the first paint.** ``SELECT COUNT(*)`` is a full scan. The first chunk is painted against ``max(rowid)``, which is O(1), and that number is *always* rendered as "≈… (estimate)". The exact ``COUNT(*)`` follows on its own job and replaces it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#6
records.source: **The count never blocks the first paint.** ``SELECT COUNT(*)`` is a full scan. The first chunk is painted against ``max(rowid)``, which is O(1), and that number is *always* rendered as "≈… (estimate)". The exact ``COUNT(*)`` follows on its own job and replaces it.
records.translation: **计数永远不会阻塞首次绘制。** ``SELECT COUNT(*)`` 需要全表扫描。第一块数据按照 ``max(rowid)`` 绘制,它是 O(1) 的,而这个数字 *始终* 显示为“≈…(估计)”。精确的 ``COUNT(*)`` 随后在独立的任务中运行并替换它。

records.context: ``worker.finished`` **is relayed through a signal into a bound method.** PySide6 delivers a plain closure connected to a worker's signal as a *direct* call on the background execution unit, and the completion handler here fills a QPlainTextEdit and a QTableWidget. Building QTextDocument children off the main GUI execution path is undefined behaviour, so ``finished`` chains through :attr:`ModelZooScreen._job_settled` — a widget-affine bound method — exactly as ``PlateViewScreen`` does.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#6
records.source: ``worker.finished`` **is relayed through a signal into a bound method.** PySide6 delivers a plain closure connected to a worker's signal as a *direct* call on the worker thread, and the completion handler here fills a QPlainTextEdit and a QTableWidget. Building QTextDocument children off the GUI thread is undefined behaviour, so ``finished`` chains through :attr:`ModelZooScreen._job_settled` — a widget-affine bound method — exactly as ``PlateViewScreen`` does.
records.translation: ``worker.finished`` **通过信号转发到一个绑定方法。** PySide6 会把连接到工作者信号上的普通闭包作为工作线程上的 *直接* 调用来执行,而这里的完成处理函数会填充一个 QPlainTextEdit 和一个 QTableWidget。在 GUI 线程之外创建 QTextDocument 子对象属于未定义行为,因此 ``finished`` 通过 :attr:`ModelZooScreen._job_settled` ——一个具有控件线程亲和性的绑定方法——进行转接,与 ``PlateViewScreen`` 的做法完全一致。

records.source: **Off the GUI thread, and the thread actually retires.** A full sweep is minutes. records.context: The profile is the default for one reason that outweighs its cost: **the Wald interval is finite by construction.** It is ``L ± t·SE``, so it returns a tidy, symmetric, entirely fictional interval for a curve whose midpoint the data does not locate at all — which is exactly the case this module exists to catch. The profile interval can *fail to close*: the residual sum of squares stays under the threshold all the way out to a concentration ten thousand times the highest dose tested, and that failure is the diagnostic. It is reported as an open bound, not smoothed into a number.

records.translation: 默认使用剖面似然区间,原因只有一个,但足以抵消其代价: **Wald 区间在构造上必然是有限的。** 它就是 ``L ± t·SE`` ,所以即使数据完全无法确定曲线的中点,它也会给出一个整齐、对称、却完全虚构的区间——而这恰恰是本模块要捕捉的情况。剖面区间则可能 *无法闭合* :残差平方和一直低于阈值,直到浓度达到最高测试剂量的一万倍,而这种失败本身就是诊断信息。它会被报告为开放边界,而不会被平滑成一个数字。

records.context: 1. **The curve is incomplete** — one plateau was never reached, or the midpoint sits outside the tested range. Then the EC50 is an extrapolation. :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50` is ``None`` in that case and the number lives in :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_unconstrained`, under a name that cannot be mistaken for a result; :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_bounded` is ``False`` and :meth:`DoseResponseResult.bound_statement` gives the one-sided fact the experiment does support ("EC50 > 30 µM, the highest concentration tested"). Three independent detectors have to agree it is fine before a number is released: the fitted midpoint inside the tested dose range, the observed responses bracketing the fitted half-maximum, and neither fitted plateau more than :data:`PLATEAU_SLACK` of the observed response span outside the observed responses. 2. **The data is not monotone.** A bell shape — the classic being cytotoxicity killing the signal at the top dose — is not a 4PL, and a 4PL fitted to it returns a confident EC50 for a curve of the wrong shape. Detected from the concentration-ordered per-dose medians and **refused**, with the concentrations where it turns named in the message. See :func:`monotonicity`. 3. **There is not enough experiment.** Four parameters need at least four distinct concentrations (:data:`MIN_DOSES`) and, to say anything about uncertainty, more observations than parameters (:data:`MIN_OBSERVATIONS`). A constant response has no curve in it. A **zero concentration is not an error** — a vehicle control is normal and belongs in the file — so it is excluded from the fit deliberately, counted, and reported as a reference response, never fed to ``log10``. A *negative* concentration has no such reading and is refused.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#23

records.translation: 1. **曲线不完整** ——某个平台从未达到,或者中点落在测试范围之外。此时 EC50 是外推值。在这种情况下 :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50` 为 ``None`` ,该数字保存在 :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_unconstrained` 中,这个名称不会被误认为是结果; :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_bounded` 为 ``False`` ,而 :meth:`DoseResponseResult.bound_statement` 给出实验确实能够支持的单侧结论(“EC50 > 30 µM,即测试的最高浓度”)。在发布一个数字之前,必须有三个独立的检测器一致认为没有问题:拟合的中点位于测试剂量范围内;观测到的响应覆盖拟合的半最大值两侧;并且两个拟合平台都没有超出观测响应范围的 :data:`PLATEAU_SLACK` 以上。 2. **数据不是单调的。** 钟形曲线——典型情况是最高剂量下的细胞毒性抑制了信号——不是 4PL,而对它拟合 4PL 会为一条形状错误的曲线返回一个看似可信的 EC50。这种情况通过按浓度排序的各剂量中位数检测出来并 **拒绝** ,消息中会指出曲线转折处的浓度。参见 :func:`monotonicity` 。 3. **实验量不足。** 四个参数至少需要四个不同的浓度( :data:`MIN_DOSES` ),而要对不确定性作出任何判断,观测数还必须多于参数数( :data:`MIN_OBSERVATIONS` )。恒定的响应中不包含曲线。 **零浓度不是错误** ——溶剂对照很正常,本就应该在文件中——因此它会被有意排除在拟合之外,计入统计,并作为参考响应报告,绝不会传给 ``log10`` 。 *负* 浓度则没有这样的解释,会被拒绝。

records.context: **The asymmetry problem is real and is not fixed by choosing a bigger c.** Tukey's fence is symmetric in the quartiles, and a right-skewed distribution therefore has far more mass beyond the upper fence than beyond the lower one *by construction*, whatever the data. For a lognormal with sigma = 1 the standard fence flags about 8% of the sample on the right and essentially nothing on the left — and it does so for a perfectly clean sample. Read uncorrected, "8% of my cells are outliers" is a statement about the shape of the distribution, not about the cells.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#13
records.source: **The asymmetry problem is real and is not fixed by choosing a bigger c.** Tukey's fence is symmetric in the quartiles, and a right-skewed distribution therefore has far more mass beyond the upper fence than beyond the lower one *by construction*, whatever the data. For a lognormal with sigma = 1 the standard fence flags about 8% of the sample on the right and essentially nothing on the left — and it does so for a perfectly clean sample. Read uncorrected, "8% of my cells are outliers" is a statement about the shape of the distribution, not about the cells.
records.translation: **不对称问题确实存在,而且不能靠选择更大的 c 来解决。** Tukey 栅栏在四分位数上是对称的,因此无论数据如何,右偏分布在上栅栏之外的质量 *在构造上* 就远多于下栅栏之外。对于 sigma = 1 的对数正态分布,标准栅栏会把右侧约 8% 的样本标记出来,而左侧几乎一个都没有——即使样本完全干净也是如此。如果不加校正地解读,“我的细胞中有 8% 是离群值”只是在描述分布的形状,而不是在描述细胞。

records.context: The obvious thing to write here is ``|x - mean| / sd > 3``, and it is the one thing this module refuses to do. spaCR object measurements are skewed and heavy-tailed by construction: ``cell_area`` is a positive quantity with a long right tail, ``pathogen_area`` is zero-inflated, an intensity ratio has a denominator that can approach zero. The mean and the SD of such a column are themselves dragged by the very objects they are supposed to find — one debris particle measured at 40× the median area moves the mean, inflates the SD, and so raises the threshold that was meant to catch it. The failure is silent and it gets worse the worse the contamination is: this is the *masking* effect, and it is the reason robust statistics exist.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#2
records.source: The obvious thing to write here is ``|x - mean| / sd > 3``, and it is the one thing this module refuses to do. spaCR object measurements are skewed and heavy-tailed by construction: ``cell_area`` is a positive quantity with a long right tail, ``pathogen_area`` is zero-inflated, an intensity ratio has a denominator that can approach zero. The mean and the SD of such a column are themselves dragged by the very objects they are supposed to find — one debris particle measured at 40× the median area moves the mean, inflates the SD, and so raises the threshold that was meant to catch it. The failure is silent and it gets worse the worse the contamination is: this is the *masking* effect, and it is the reason robust statistics exist.
records.translation: 这里最显而易见的写法是 ``|x - mean| / sd > 3`` ,而这恰恰是本模块拒绝做的事。 spaCR 的对象测量值天然就是偏态且重尾的: ``cell_area`` 是带有长右尾的正值量, ``pathogen_area`` 是零膨胀的,强度比值的分母可能趋近于零。这类列的均值和 SD 本身就会被它们本应找出的那些对象拖偏——一个面积为中位数 40× 的碎片颗粒会移动均值、放大 SD,从而抬高原本用来捕捉它的阈值。这种失败是无声的,而且污染越严重就越糟:这就是 *掩蔽* 效应,也正是稳健统计存在的原因。

records.context: **Isolation forest requires** ``contamination`` — the share of the data that is bad — declared *in advance*. That share is precisely the unknown the analysis is trying to estimate. Setting ``contamination=0.01`` guarantees 1% of the objects come back flagged whether the plate is pristine or ruined, which makes the output uninterpretable in exactly the case it matters.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#20
records.source: **Isolation forest requires** ``contamination`` — the share of the data that is bad — declared *in advance*. That share is precisely the unknown the analysis is trying to estimate. Setting ``contamination=0.01`` guarantees 1% of the objects come back flagged whether the plate is pristine or ruined, which makes the output uninterpretable in exactly the case it matters.
records.translation: **孤立森林要求** ``contamination`` ——即坏数据所占的比例——必须 *预先* 声明。而这个比例恰恰是分析试图估计的未知量。设置 ``contamination=0.01`` 可以保证无论板是完好无损还是彻底报废,都会有 1% 的对象被标记,这使得输出恰恰在最关键的情况下无法解读。

records.context: **MCD is affine-equivariant.** Rescale ``area`` from px^2 to um^2, or rotate to any linear combination of the features, and the fitted centre and covariance transform with it: every distance, and so every flag, is unchanged. This is the same invariance argument :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model` makes for standardising before a PCA, and it is why no scaling option is needed here — the metric *is* the covariance. A tree ensemble splits on raw coordinates and is not equivariant; its answer depends on the units.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#21

A tree ensemble splits on raw coordinates and is not equivariant; its answer depends on the units.
records.translation: **MCD 具有仿射等变性。** 把 ``area`` 从 px^2 换算成 um^2,或者旋转为特征的任意线性组合,拟合出的中心和协方差都会随之变换:每一个距离、因而每一个标记都保持不变。这与 :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model` 为在 PCA 之前进行标准化所给出的不变性论证相同,也正是这里不需要任何缩放选项的原因——度量 *就是* 协方差。树集成模型在原始坐标上进行划分,不具备等变性;它的结果取决于单位。

records.context: **MCD is the multivariate generalisation of the median and the MAD.** The MCD centre is a multivariate median (the mean of the h-subset of minimum covariance determinant) and the MCD scatter is its spread. So all three methods offered here are the same idea at one, one, and p dimensions, and a user who understands the MAD already understands this.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#22

So all three methods offered here are the same idea at one, one, and p dimensions, and a user who understands the MAD already understands this.
records.translation: **MCD 是中位数和 MAD 在多变量情形下的推广。** MCD 中心是一个多变量中位数(协方差行列式最小的 h 子集的均值),而 MCD 散布矩阵就是它的离散程度。因此,这里提供的三种方法是同一个思想分别在一维、一维和 p 维上的体现,理解 MAD 的用户也就已经理解了这一方法。

records.context: Take 60 objects per well, a feature whose within-well spread is sigma, and a well whose whole population is shifted by 0.9 sigma. The **object** rule at k = 3.5 asks each object to exceed 3.5 sigma; a 0.9 sigma shift moves that requirement to 2.6 sigma, which about one object in 200 clears — so the bad well contributes a fraction of one extra flagged object and disappears into the ordinary tail. The **well** rule compares well *medians*, whose sampling spread is only ``1.2533 * sigma / sqrt(60) = 0.16 sigma``; the same shift is then 5.6 robust SDs and the well is unmistakable. The two tests have wildly different power against the same defect, which is why both are run and both are reported.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#28

The two tests have wildly different power against the same defect, which is why both are run and both are reported.
records.translation: 设每个孔有 60 个对象,某个特征在孔内的离散度为 sigma,而有一个孔的整个群体偏移了 0.9 sigma。 k = 3.5 时的 **对象** 规则要求每个对象超过 3.5 sigma;0.9 sigma 的偏移会把这一要求降到 2.6 sigma,大约每 200 个对象中只有一个能超过——因此这个异常孔只会多贡献不到一个被标记的对象,并淹没在普通的尾部中。 **孔** 规则比较的是各孔的 *中位数* ,其抽样离散度仅为 ``1.2533 * sigma / sqrt(60) = 0.16 sigma`` ;同样的偏移此时相当于 5.6 个稳健 SD,这个孔一目了然。两种检验针对同一缺陷的检验效能差异巨大,这就是两者都会运行、也都会报告的原因。

records.context: The well-level test is **different from counting flagged objects**. ``flagged_share`` provides that count and answers another question: it finds a few *catastrophic* objects, such as a segmentation failure or dust measured as a cell, but misses a uniform shift. The well-level robust score finds the uniform shift but misses an isolated catastrophe. Both belong on the well frame because neither replaces the other.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#29
records.source: So the well pass is emphatically **not** "the well contains many flagged objects". That statistic exists — it is reported as ``flagged_share`` — and it answers a different question: it finds a well containing a few *catastrophic* objects (a segmentation blow-up, a piece of dust measured as a cell) while being blind to a uniform shift. The well-level robust score finds the uniform shift while being blind to the isolated catastrophe. Both are on the well frame because neither subsumes the other.
records.translation: 因此,按孔进行的这一轮检查明确 **不是** “该孔包含很多被标记的对象”。那个统计量确实存在——以 ``flagged_share`` 报告——但它回答的是另一个问题:它能找出包含少数 *灾难性* 对象的孔(分割严重失败、一粒被当作细胞测量的灰尘),却看不到整体性的均匀偏移。孔级稳健分数能发现均匀偏移,却看不到孤立的灾难。两者都放在孔级数据表中,因为谁也不能涵盖对方。

records.context: **MAD == 0 is handled, not divided by.** When more than half the objects share one value — a zero-inflated ``pathogen_area``, an integer count, a saturated intensity — the MAD is exactly zero. Naively, every value that differs at all then scores infinity and *the entire tail is flagged*, which is the opposite of robust. So :func:`robust_scale` falls back to the **mean absolute deviation from the median**, scaled by :data:`MEAN_AD_TO_SIGMA` = ``sqrt(pi/2)`` = 1.2533 (for a Gaussian ``E|X - mu| = sigma * sqrt(2/pi)``), and says so in :attr:`OutlierResult.notes` and in :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#8
records.source: **MAD == 0 is handled, not divided by.** When more than half the objects share one value — a zero-inflated ``pathogen_area``, an integer count, a saturated intensity — the MAD is exactly zero. Naively, every value that differs at all then scores infinity and *the entire tail is flagged*, which is the opposite of robust. So :func:`robust_scale` falls back to the **mean absolute deviation from the median**, scaled by :data:`MEAN_AD_TO_SIGMA` = ``sqrt(pi/2)`` = 1.2533 (for a Gaussian ``E|X - mu| = sigma * sqrt(2/pi)``), and says so in :attr:`OutlierResult.notes` and in :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`.
records.translation: **MAD == 0 会被专门处理,而不会被用作除数。** 当超过一半的对象共享同一个值时——例如零膨胀的 ``pathogen_area`` 、整数计数或饱和强度—— MAD 恰好为零。若天真地处理,任何稍有不同的值都会得到无穷大的分数, *整个尾部都会被标记* ,这与稳健恰恰相反。因此 :func:`robust_scale` 会退回到 **相对于中位数的平均绝对偏差** ,并用 :data:`MEAN_AD_TO_SIGMA` = ``sqrt(pi/2)`` = 1.2533 进行缩放(对于高斯分布, ``E|X - mu| = sigma * sqrt(2/pi)`` ),同时在 :attr:`OutlierResult.notes` 和 :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats` 中予以说明。

records.context: The alternative considered and not taken is the Rousseeuw–Croux ``Sn`` (``1.1926 * med_i med_j |x_i - x_j|``), which is the statistically better answer: it has a 50% breakdown point, needs no symmetry assumption, and does not collapse on tied data. It is not used because the naive form is O(n^2) — unusable on the 10^5–10^6 object rows spaCR routinely produces — and the O(n log n) algorithm is a page of intricate code to maintain for a path that is only ever reached when the MAD has *already* collapsed. The mean absolute deviation has a 0% breakdown point and that is stated plainly rather than glossed: it is a stopgap that keeps a degenerate column from flagging its whole tail, not a robust estimator. If the fallback fires, the honest reading is that the column is not continuous enough for this test.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#9

It is not used because the naive form is O(n^2) — unusable on the 10^5–10^6 object rows spaCR routinely produces — and the O(n log n) algorithm is a page of intricate code to maintain for a path that is only ever reached when the MAD has *already* collapsed. If the fallback fires, the honest reading is that the column is not continuous enough for this test.
records.translation: 曾考虑但未采用的替代方案是 Rousseeuw–Croux 的 ``Sn`` ( ``1.1926 * med_i med_j |x_i - x_j|`` ),从统计角度看它是更好的答案:它的崩溃点为 50%,不需要对称性假设,并且在数据存在大量相同值时也不会失效。之所以不用它,是因为朴素实现是 O(n^2) ——在 spaCR 经常产生的 10^5–10^6 行对象数据上根本无法使用——而 O(n log n) 算法则是一整页复杂的代码,却只为维护一条仅在 MAD *已经* 失效时才会走到的路径。平均绝对偏差的崩溃点是 0%,这一点会被直接说明而不是含糊带过:它只是一个权宜之计,用来防止退化的列把整个尾部都标记出来,而不是一个稳健估计量。如果触发了这一回退,诚实的解读是:该列不够连续,不适合做这项检验。
